name: Para 01 Moss Terrarium
description:
The Para 01 Moss Terrarium is a self-contained ecosystem featuring living Octoblepharum albidum moss growing on a custom-designed 3D-printed structure.


A built-in water reservoir and fitted glass dome work together to maintain humidity, creating the ideal environment for healthy moss growth with very little maintenance.


Materials Included
3D-printed structure
Glass dome
Living Octoblepharum albidum moss
